maintenance_led.reason: Sells prescription kidney drugs (Vafseo, Auryxia) for ongoing patient treatment, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Vafseo and Auryxia are used mainly by dialysis and CKD patients, largely covered by Medicare and Medicaid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own drug development and sales; the Keryx merger was a single deal, not a steady stream.

mission_critical.reason: Prescription therapies for kidney disease complications; switching needs physician decisions, carries patient risk, and involves regulatory-approved treatment protocols.

notes: Payer mix comes from general knowledge of dialysis and Medicare coverage, not from the website text.
